title: Tool script variables do not update before restarting scene
body:
### Tested versions

Tested in Godot Engine v4.4.rc1.official [8ed125b42]

### System information

Godot v4.4.rc1 - macOS Sonoma (14.6.1) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon Pro 5300M - Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-9980HK CPU @ 2.40GHz (16 threads)

### Issue description

When you have a variable declared in a script that contains `@tool`, the variable is not updated when the script is ran in the editor.

### Steps to reproduce

Add the following script to a Control node:

```gdscript
@tool
extends Control

var aux : String = "aux"

@export var reload: bool = false:
	set(value):
		print(aux)
```
Reload the scene (not to be confused with https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/95268)

- Clicking on reload in the editor prints "aux" to the Output.
- Change the variable `var aux : String = "not aux"`.
- Save the script.

**Expected behaviour:**

- Clicking on reload in the editor prints "not aux" to the Output.

**Current behaviour:**
- Clicking on reload in the editor still prints "aux" to the Output.

Current work around:
Reload the scene

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[editor-variable-cache-bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19027090/editor-variable-cache-bug.zip)
